title: 中国最早的人类及夏商西周
subtitle: Earliest Humans & the Xia, Shang, Western Zhou

cards.back: archaeology (studying the past by digging up old things)
cards.example: 考古证明中国很早就有原始人类。
cards.exampleTranslation: Archaeology proves China had primitive humans very early.
cards.breakdown: 考：老人低头，仔细琢磨很久 · 古：十张口一代代传下来的老故事

cards.back: tribe (an early group of people living together)
cards.example: 黄帝部落和炎帝部落联合起来。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Yellow Emperor's tribe and the Yan Emperor's tribe joined together.
cards.breakdown: 部：一个片区（阝）分成好几块 · 落：草木（艹）落下的地方，人们聚居的村落

cards.back: calendar (the system for counting days and years)
cards.exampleTranslation: The Xia dynasty already had a calendar.
cards.breakdown: 历：一片片经历过的日子 · 法：像水（氵）一样有规矩的方法

cards.back: bloodline / blood relationship (family by birth)
cards.example: 宗法制以血缘关系为基础。
cards.exampleTranslation: The patriarchal clan system was based on bloodline.
cards.breakdown: 血：盘子里盛着的一滴血 · 缘：丝线（纟）把一家人连在一起的关系

cards.back: slave (a person forced to work with no freedom)
cards.example: 商朝大批奴隶在田里耕作。
cards.exampleTranslation: In the Shang dynasty large numbers of slaves worked in the fields.
cards.breakdown: 奴：一只手（又）牢牢抓住一个女子，不放她自由 · 隶：被人管着、跟在后面的仆人

cards.back: large numbers of / a large batch of
cards.exampleTranslation: Large numbers of slaves worked together.
cards.breakdown: 大：张开双臂的大 · 批：用手（扌）一次比较、分出一大堆

cards.back: to till / farm the land
cards.breakdown: 耕：用农具（耒）在田地（井）里翻土 · 作：一个人（亻）动手干活

cards.back: to cast / mould (metal into shapes)
cards.example: 商朝的青铜铸造十分发达。
cards.exampleTranslation: Bronze casting was highly developed in the Shang dynasty.
cards.breakdown: 铸：把金属（钅）熔化后倒进模子，做成长久（寿）的器物 · 造：走（辶）到作坊里制作东西

cards.back: to inherit (a title or throne passed down through the family)
cards.example: 启继承父位，开始了世袭王朝。
cards.exampleTranslation: Qi inherited his father's position, starting a hereditary dynasty.
cards.breakdown: 世：一代又一代 · 袭：龙袍（衣）一代传给一代

cards.back: legitimate (the main wife's son, of the proper line)
cards.example: 西周实行嫡长子继承权。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Western Zhou practiced inheritance by the eldest legitimate son.
cards.breakdown: 嫡：正妻（女）生的、地位最正统的那一个

cards.back: feudal lord / vassal (a nobleman given land by the king)
cards.example: 天子把土地分给功臣，建立诸侯国。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Son of Heaven gave land to meritorious officials to set up vassal states.
cards.breakdown: 诸：许多（诸多）的意思 · 侯：受封（亻）掌管一方的贵族

cards.back: patriarchal clan system (rules based on family bloodline)
cards.exampleTranslation: The Western Zhou established the patriarchal clan system.
cards.breakdown: 宗：屋顶（宀）下供着祖先牌位（示），一家之本 · 法：像水（氵）一样有规矩的制度

cards.back: to move / relocate / shift
cards.example: 周平王迁都洛阳，建立了东周。
cards.exampleTranslation: King Ping of Zhou moved the capital to Luoyang and founded the Eastern Zhou.
cards.breakdown: 迁：走（辶）到很远（千）的地方，搬家

cards.back: the Huaxia people – the ancestors of the Chinese nation
'descendants of Yan and Huang' – what Chinese people call themselves
the Yellow Emperor – legendary ancestor of the Chinese
the Yan Emperor – legendary ancestor who joined with the Yellow Emperor
Chi You – tribal leader defeated by Yan and Huang
abdication – choosing a talented person as the new leader
oracle bone script – writing carved on turtle shells and animal bones
bronze inscriptions – characters cast onto bronze vessels
the Xia dynasty – China's first slave-owning state
the Shang dynasty – known for oracle bones and bronze casting
the Western Zhou – used the feudal and patriarchal clan systems
